{{Quote|What are the sixth and seventh Rules of Engagement, Padawan?|Qui-Gon Jinn to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>}}
The '''Rules of Engagement''' were the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] rules for engaging an enemy in combat. A [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] was required to learn and exercise these rules before they were allowed to obtain the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] tested his Padawan [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on these rules during the [[Dorvalla Incident]] <ref name="CoD" /> in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].<ref name="tnec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref>

==Rules of Engagement==
Known Rules of Engagement are listed below:
*''A Jedi uses the Force and the lightsaber only for defense, never for Attack.''
*''Understand the dark and light in all things.''
*''Learn to see accurately.''
*''Open your eyes to what is not evident.''
*''Exercise caution, even in trivial manners.''
